<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

The general laws of contacts and stock (Becoming.Contacts, Becoming.Stock) carry the connection from consequence to later use. With the lumping through a contact plan, a change of plan keeps every old selection exactly where it retains every old contact (Contacts.keeps_iff_retains); a revision rule answers every failure exactly where it puts the failed address into the next plan (Contacts.answers_iff), and a rule that does not read failures leaves some failure unanswered at every plan once addresses are unbounded (Contacts.blind_misses); two reference responses drive a two-valued channel to both targets exactly when they differ, and an installed encoding stays right exactly where the new channel agrees with the old at the encoded inputs (References.drives_iff, References.stays_iff); a fuelled course is executable exactly where it is covered (Stock.feasible_iff_covered). ReferencePlan is an instance: its fuel is conserved and drawn only from what is held (balanced, draws_held, trace_conserves_of_law), and its revision contacts every failed address (propose_answers, revise_registers_failure). Within the shared Process/Trace, an acquired mismatch address revises a retained contact sequence; the controller executes it, acquires bound reference pairs, checks separation, installs fresh records and changes actual later response; a second mismatch revises the method again without resetting fuel (complete_history, revision_binds_plan, second_installed_choice). New installed contacts reuse Through and old-choice preservation directly reuses selection-under-registration-revision. The controls are failure directions of the general laws: the frozen method is a rule that does not read failures (frozen_blind, frozen_misses), constant references fail drives_iff, post-check drift is inverted_fails (drift_fails), insufficient fuel is an uncovered course, and an erased mismatch cannot activate (erased_mismatch_cannot_activate).

Canonical source: [ReferencePlan.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/ReferencePlan.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- Supplied addressed Boolean contacts, targets and ordinary undertaking order, faithful actual return, bound reference pairs and stable correspondence between checking and use.
- The revision rule prepends an acquired failed address to the retained sequence; checking requires each reference pair to separate, with operative assembly and retention. Formation of those primitives and revision/check rules is not claimed explained.
- Each ordinary operation uses one unit of fuel and each reference pair two; every step must be covered by the fuel held. The witness starts with 30 and has no replenishment; these are not universal physical amounts or molecular stocks.
- Candidate novelty is relative to the current contact plan and apparatus; primitives and address space remain in the supplied encompassing law. The lumping concerns installed contacts, with actual encoding and use checked separately. Ordinary return is another actual relationship within the whole; the lumping through installed references is not total system access. Drift is an admitted primitive of the same process that uses fuel.

Activity, return, method, apparatus, support and response are differentiated roles within one unfolding. P99 is a new shared-spine instance. Existing inquiry, method-formation, calibration and transmission results are credited, not claimed formally concatenated across all older chemical/network models. A fixed encompassing law does not erase internal method change or discharge scientific premises.
